name: gtm-api: LinkedIn MCP Server
author: gtm-api
description: The LinkedIn API and MCP server for AI agents: search, connect, message and enrich on accounts you own, with limits enforced on our server. One URL exposes 250+ typed actions behind three meta tools, and every outward action goes through preview and confirm. 20,000+ LinkedIn accounts run on this stack, and under 1% of them have ever been restricted.

tools.name: list_toolsets
tools.description: List the available toolsets (domains) on this server. Each toolset groups related tools (e.g. linkedin.messaging, id.billing). Start here, then get_toolset_tools to inspect one, then call_tool to run a tool. Requires OAuth authorization (Bearer token).

tools.name: get_toolset_tools
tools.description: List the tools in a toolset. Default (lite) returns name + title + one-line summary; pass verbose:true for full descriptions, safety flags, and parameter names. Run one via call_tool.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Invoke a tool by name (discovered via get_toolset_tools) with its arguments object. Behaves exactly like calling the tool on its domain mount. Dangerous tools still require the two-step preview-confirm (pass commit_token inside arguments on the confirm call).
